title: Computer vision tracks pig activity changes at higher greenhouse gas levels
summary: YOLOv4 with Deep-SORT tracking measured pig postures and activity while barn ventilation was closed for an hour three times a day. Pigs stood and walked less and lay more laterally at higher greenhouse gas concentration; detection mAP was 98.67%, with MOTA 93.86% and MOTP 82.41%. The behavioural sample size is not stated in the abstract.
ai_technology: YOLOv4 object detection with Deep-SORT tracking to quantify pig postures and activities

evidence.tested: Controlled ventilation-closure treatment with before, during and after observation; detector test metrics.
evidence.unknown: Sample size and welfare outcomes are not given in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Detected and tracked pigs to measure the behavioural response.
